# llms.txt for DIZO Plastic Welding Solutions

> DIZO specializes in advanced ultrasonic plastic welding equipment tailored for automotive, medical, electronics, and textile applications. Their automated solutions are designed to meet precision and efficiency requirements across global manufacturing industries.

DIZO develops and manufactures high-performance plastic welders and intelligent automation systems. Their core capabilities include ultrasonic welding, spin welding, hot plate welding, and robotic integration for factory automation. The company supports manufacturers through custom engineering, production support, and global delivery.
